thesis: Alnylam (Nasdaq: ALNY). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-29) read in part (statements, revenue by product, balance sheet). Q3 revenue 1,458.1M vs 1,249.0M (+16.7%); 9M 3,916.2M vs 2,616.9M (+49.6%). AMVUTTRA Q3 1,130.4M (US 908.6M), ONPATTRO 19.6M, royalties 94.7M (46.2M prior). Q3 pretax income 295.8M but net income 2,167.3M because of a 1,871.5M income tax benefit; deferred tax assets rose to 2,006.7M from 126.0M (a valuation allowance release is an inference, not read). TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 5,013.2M, GAAP NI 2,724.2M (not usable for P/E), OCF 901.8M, capex 149.6M, FCF 752.2M, SBC 307.5M, FCF after SBC 444.7M. Close 149.40 (2026-11-18) x 133,937,576 shares (10-Q cover, 2026-10-23) = 20.01B market cap; FCF yield 3.8% (2.2% after SBC); EV/revenue about 3.5x after net cash of about 2.57B (cash 1,754.3M + marketable securities 1,832.9M - convertible notes 1,012.6M), before 1,734.8M royalty and development funding liabilities. Operating income Q3 345.8M (23.7% margin). Price implies continued rapid AMVUTTRA growth with margin expansion; a 3.8% FCF yield on 50% growth is not clearly cheap or expensive without peer and margin trajectory evidence.
counterthesis: Product concentration (AMVUTTRA is 78% of Q3 revenue) with competition in ATTR cardiomyopathy. GAAP EPS of 15.72 in Q3 is a tax artifact and will mislead any trailing P/E. SBC is large (307.5M TTM, 41% of FCF). Capex rose to 126.3M in 9M26 from 35.4M. Royalty and development funding liabilities of 1.73B plus convertible notes reduce net cash. Stock fell 4.5% on 11-18 and 7% over two sessions for a reason not identified. Peers (BBIO, ARGX, ITCI) not compared.
invalidation: Invalidated if AMVUTTRA growth stalls, operating margin stops expanding, cash conversion falls below about 15% of revenue, or the tax benefit proves to rest on assumptions of future profit that fail.
